baseline.source_contract: reference-only deterministic compiler; caller supplies cost_units; compiler does not read payload bytes
baseline.current_trigger4_owner: F2-WP-306 generation-4 renderer/tokenizer cost-witness binding claim

architecture_delta.reason: PR #519 falsifies naked caller cost_units as exact rendered/tokenized-cost evidence; external primary docs show rendering template, special-token policy and tokenizer artifacts determine the actual token sequence.

renderer_config_must_bind_when_applicabl: tool/schema inputs or their digest when template-visible

fail_closed_invariants: No exact renderer identity => no exact token-cost witness.
No exact tokenizer artifact identity => no exact token-cost witness.
Rendered bytes digest mismatch => reject witness.
Token-id digest/count not reproducible under bound tokenizer/runtime => reject witness.
Naked cost_units never self-promotes to token_count.
A model/provider/runtime may consume the witness only at the exact bound scope; witness existence does not mint model-quality or runtime acceptance.

recommended_semantics.cost_units: retain as abstract caller/admission scheduling quantity unless a future owner-approved migration explicitly changes its contract
recommended_semantics.token_count: separate measured quantity with exact renderer/tokenizer provenance
recommended_semantics.selection_integration: Trigger-4 generation-4 owner chooses whether to require/revalidate the witness at admission or downstream model-context assembly; Trigger-6 does not mutate implementation.

external_primary_evidence.claim: structured chat messages are converted through model-specific templates to actual token sequences; direct tokenize=True avoids special-token duplication hazards
chat_template is renderer logic associated with the tokenizer and receives template-visible configuration/inputs
concrete pinned tokenizer configuration includes model-specific chat_template and explicit special tokens; example only, not F2 target selection

counterhypotheses.statement: A fixed character/byte heuristic could be enough and exact tokenization is unnecessary.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: renderer/tokenizer-bound measurement disagrees with heuristic while exact budget matters

counterhypotheses.statement: The witness should be embedded directly into ContextCompiler and make it read payload bytes.
counterhypotheses.reason: would erase the current reference-only authority boundary; cheaper design is a separate typed witness/admission boundary
tokenizer normalization/model/post-processing and special-token configuration also determine token IDs/count

next_exact_gate: Trigger-4 F2-WP-306 generation-4 owner should bind its proposed witness to exact renderer/tokenizer artifact identities and add positive + negative tests: valid exact witness admitted; changed payload/render config/tokenizer artifact/generation rejected; naked scalar rejected wherever exact token budget is asserted. Production token-cost credit remains blocked until the actual F2 target renderer/tokenizer identity is selected and reproduced.
